findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_grammar, pptx_clean, pptx_compress_medium, pptx_compress_size, json_to_pptx, pptx_accessibility_check, pptx_redact · Private data: generate_password, estimate_password_strength, pdf_split, pdf_compress_lossless_bw, pdf_compress_smallest_bw, pdf_compress_greyscale, pdf_compress_balanced, pdf_compress_aggressive, pdf_compress_extreme, pdf_compress_size, image_convert, video_compress, audio_merge, audio_compress, audio_remove_silence, pptx_extract_notes, pptx_extract_images, pptx_compress_size, pptx_split, pptx_merge, csv_to_pptx, pptx_extract_charts, pptx_accessibility_check, pptx_repair, pptx_redact, pptx_html_slideshow, converters_file_size · Public sink: extract_emails, pdf_compress_size, audio_normalize, pptx_clean, pptx_compress_medium, pptx_compress_size, json_to_pptx, pptx_redact · Destructive: format_json, audio_remove_silence, pptx_extract_text, pptx_extract_notes, pptx_organize, json_to_pptx, pptx_find_replace, pptx_slide_numbers, pptx_watermark, pptx_extract_charts, pptx_redact, pptx_to_template, text_paper_format.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_loan" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Loan calculator client and server side from freedailypro — EMI / amortizing loan" → after: "Loan calculator client and server side from freedailypro — EMI / amortizing loan, with an optional first payment date that dates the schedule preview and gives the payoff date"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
